toegepas.voor: Trek jou hand van jou nek af
toegepas.na: Gly met jou hand van jou nek af
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Trek jou hand' is unidiomatic for running a hand along the back; 'gly met jou hand' is the natural expression.
toegepas.fout: 'Trek jou hand van jou nek af' first reads as 'pull your hand away from your neck', not as running it down the back.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Gly met jou hand' is the natural expression for the action and the meaning (neck down to the lower back) is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Bare singular 'Vis' breaks the parallel with the other plural group names (Amfibieë, Reptiele, Voëls, Soogdiere).
toegepas.fout: Bare singular 'Vis' as a group name is unusual and breaks the parallel with the four plural group names.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Visse' is the normal Afrikaans name for the group and the rest of the sentence still agrees.

toegepas.voor: diere en die ander naam daarvoor
toegepas.na: diere, en die ander naam daarvoor
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins 'Ons noem hulle ...' and 'die ander naam daarvoor is ...', each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by the AWS 2017 and leaves the term 'ongewerwelde diere' intact.

toegepas.voor: Insekte het geen ruggraat nie en
toegepas.na: Insekte het geen ruggraat nie, en
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subjects ('Insekte' and 'hulle'); the protected wording after it is untouched.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with subjects 'Insekte' and 'hulle'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required and the protected wording 'hulle vlieg of loop op pote' after it is untouched.

toegepas.voor: 'n Skerpioen het geen ruggraat nie en 'n harde buitekant.
toegepas.na: 'n Skerpioen het geen ruggraat nie, maar wel 'n harde buitekant.
toegepas.rede_vinder: With 'en' the negation can be read as covering the hard outside too; 'maar wel' makes the contrast clear and matches the other list items.
toegepas.fout: 'geen ruggraat nie en 'n harde buitekant' can be read as negating the hard outside too, especially beside the worm item 'geen ruggraat nie en ook geen harde dop nie'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'maar wel' makes it unambiguous that the scorpion has a hard outside, which is what the original says, and matches the crab item's 'maar'.

toegepas.blok: Wat die woord bene hier beteken
toegepas.rede_vinder: A word discussed as a word is placed in quotation marks.
toegepas.fout: A word discussed as a word is unmarked, so 'Die woord bene beteken' makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Quotation marks mark the mentioned word and change nothing in the meaning.

toegepas.blok: Wat die woord bene hier beteken
toegepas.voor: Hulle loop dus op pote en het steeds geen bene nie.
toegepas.na: Hulle loop dus op pote en het tog geen bene nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'steeds' in the concessive sense of English 'still' is an anglicism; 'tog' is the Afrikaans word here, as the lesson itself uses later.
toegepas.fout: 'steeds' used in the concessive sense of English 'still' is an anglicism; in Afrikaans it suggests 'continually'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'tog' is the Afrikaans concessive word here and the claim (they walk on legs yet have no bones) is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'hou veilig teen' is wooden; 'beskerm teen' is the natural verb.
toegepas.fout: 'hou sy lyf veilig teen' is wooden.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'beskerm sy lyf teen' is the exact natural verb with the same meaning and the same two threats.

toegepas.voor: op hulle rug en ons noem dit
toegepas.na: op hulle rug, en ons noem dit
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subjects ('Baie slakke' and 'ons').
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins sentences with subjects 'Baie slakke' and 'ons'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by the AWS 2017 and changes no words.

toegepas.voor: geen dop nie en sy lyf bly
toegepas.na: geen dop nie, en sy lyf bly
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subjects ('n Wurm' and 'sy lyf').
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins sentences with subjects ''n Wurm' and 'sy lyf'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by the AWS 2017 and changes no words.

laat_vaar.voor: Ons verdeel hulle almal in twee groepe met net een enkele vraag.
laat_vaar.na: Ons verdeel hulle almal met net een vraag in twee groepe.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'net een enkele' is redundant, and the means phrase reads more naturally before the result phrase.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The sentence already flows, and 'net een enkele' is a deliberate emphasis that the next sentence pays off, so dropping it and reordering is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: Die slak bou daardie skulp self van kalk
laat_vaar.na: 'n Slak bou sy skulp self van kalk
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The previous sentence speaks of 'baie slakke', so 'die slak' and 'daardie skulp' have no single referent; a general 'n slak ... sy skulp' fits.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Die slak ... daardie skulp' ties back to the snails that carry a shell, whereas a general ''n Slak bou sy skulp' implies every snail has one and loses the 'baie' qualifier of the previous sentence.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'reguit' means straight in shape; 'direk' is the word for being attached without anything in between.
na_skrywer.fout: 'reguit ... vas' in the ruggraat definition can be read as 'straight' in shape rather than 'directly attached'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but this is a glossary definition and a word-choice change there belongs to the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: By 'n mens en by die meeste diere met 'n ruggraat is daardie stukke beentjies.
vlae.rede: The diminutive 'beentjies' suggests the pieces are small, which the protected entry for 'Een enkele ry stukke' rules false for a giraffe's neck vertebrae; whether 'bene' is meant cannot be decided without the writer, and 'bene' has its own ambiguity in this lesson.
